twin_model.config

Configuration system for performance optimization.

This module provides configuration management for simulation performance settings, including presets for different scenarios and validation.

Classes

ConfigPreset

Pre-defined configuration presets for common scenarios.

PerformanceConfig

Performance configuration for simulations.

class twin_model.config.PerformanceConfig[source]

Performance configuration for simulations.

Controls memory usage, sampling, and optimization settings for different simulation scenarios. All settings can be customized or loaded from presets.

observable_buffer_size[source]

Max events per primitive buffer

sampling_rate[source]

Event sampling frequency (1 = keep all, 100 = keep 1%)

aggregation_interval[source]

Minutes between metric aggregations

flush_interval[source]

Minutes between database flushes

cache_max_size[source]

Max events per cache file

enable_global_observables[source]

Use global event collection

simulation_mode[source]

Data collection mode (DETAILED/PRODUCTION/FAST)

max_memory_mb[source]

Memory usage limit before warning

enable_progress[source]

Show progress updates during simulation

checkpoint_interval[source]

Minutes between auto-checkpoints

chunk_size_days[source]

Days per execution chunk

batch_size[source]

Events per batch for processing

enable_monitoring[source]

Enable health monitoring

monitoring_interval[source]

Minutes between health checks
